title: RECRUITMENT OF TEACHERS AND STAFF IN EMRSs
body_text:
Union Minister of State for Tribal Affairs Shri Durgadas Uikey informed today in Lok Sabha that the Ministry of Tribal Affairs has not received any representations to reverse the centralized recruitment process for teachers and staff in Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRSs).
The Government has sanctioned 31 teaching posts and 21 non-teaching posts per EMRS for EMRSs with classes up to 12th having a full strength of 480 students to be recruited in phased manner. 13 of the 21 non-teaching posts sanctioned for each school have been earmarked for engagement through outsourcing, with the objective of promoting local employment and community participation.
Centralized recruitment mechanism through the EMRS Staff Selection Examination (ESSE) has been instituted to ensure the appointment of qualified and competent teaching and non-teaching personnel across EMRSs. 9111 teaching & non -teaching staff have already been recruited and examination has been conducted for another batch of 7267 teaching & non -teaching staff for EMRSs across the country.
Staff who have joined in EMRSs are provided with training in different areas including importance of Tribal culture, ways to improve the standard of the tribal students and learning regional languages.
To familiarise with the Tribal culture, language and local requirement arrangement is made to have sessions on local languages through State educational Societies and also through regional language teachers who are posted in EMRSs. As per the terms and conditions of offer of appointment, candidates are also required to qualify the regional language competency requirement of the State in which posting is done during the probation period.

enrichment.summary: In a Lok Sabha reply, MoS for Tribal Affairs Durgadas Uikey stated that no representations have been received to reverse the centralized recruitment process for teachers and staff in Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRSs). Each full-strength EMRS (480 students, classes up to 12th) has 31 sanctioned teaching and 21 non-teaching posts, with 13 non-teaching posts earmarked for outsourcing to promote local employment. So far 9,111 staff have been recruited through the EMRS Staff Selection Examination (ESSE), and exams have been conducted for another 7,267 posts.
enrichment.context: EMRSs are residential schools set up under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs to provide quality education to Scheduled Tribe (ST) students, modeled on Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas, with priority for areas with significant tribal population. Under the revamped scheme, EMRSs are being scaled up nationwide, with a target to cover blocks having more than 50% ST population and at least 20,000 tribal persons, aiming to open around 452 new schools. Centralized recruitment via ESSE was introduced to standardize hiring, ensure quality and reduce vacancies that had historically plagued EMRSs due to fragmented, state-level recruitment. This move parallels broader concerns about staffing shortages and infrastructure gaps in tribal education institutions raised in parliamentary committees. Balancing centralized standardization with local cultural and linguistic sensitivity is addressed by requiring staff to learn regional languages and undergo training on tribal culture, since teacher-student cultural rapport significantly affects tribal students' learning outcomes and retention.

prelims_questions.question:
With reference to Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRSs), consider the following statements:
1. EMRSs are set up exclusively for Scheduled Tribe (ST) students.
2. Recruitment of teaching and non-teaching staff is now conducted through a centralized examination called ESSE.
3. EMRSs function under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
prelims_questions.explanation: EMRSs are residential schools for ST students functioning under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, and staff recruitment is now centralized through the EMRS Staff Selection Examination (ESSE), as stated in the release.

prelims_questions.question: As per sanctioned norms mentioned for Eklavya Model Residential Schools with classes up to 12th and full strength of 480 students, how many teaching and non-teaching posts are sanctioned respectively?
prelims_questions.explanation: The release states 31 teaching posts and 21 non-teaching posts are sanctioned per full-strength EMRS with classes up to 12th.
